scope: C-012 strict evening view/save, atomic feedback/helpfulness/task revisions, encrypted optional note, Safety input diversion, continuation, history projection and Mini Program unknown-outcome recovery

assertions: strict coordinated input binds feedback/helpfulness/task revisions and rejects owner, guard, window and relationship authority
note SET/CLEAR shapes, real-state enums, client view and Safety overlay are closed executable schemas
authenticated OpenAPI evening paths resolve to the shared request and view contracts
one command saves and replays one allowlisted evening view while changed payload conflicts
HIGH_RISK returns SAFETY_OVERLAY and never invokes the ordinary EveningStore
HTTP responses and ordinary logs contain no note, ciphertext, account, guard or fingerprint

T-C012-DB-001.selector: C-008 real PostgreSQL idempotent generation, publication and guard fences
assertions: real PostgreSQL 18 commits feedback, helpfulness, optional task and aggregate revisions together
one stale component revision leaves all component and aggregate revisions unchanged
optional note persists only as ciphertext/key version and never enters the outbox payload
api-safety pool writes one minimal decision/event/plan/state and same-command replay is idempotent
a changed high-risk command fingerprint conflicts and no ordinary evening row is created for the Safety account
UNRATED remains no helpfulness row and an EVE empty continuation grant legally binds revision zero
CLEAR note is protected before the ordinary store receives it
HIGH_RISK activates the dedicated Safety port before any ordinary transaction
INDETERMINATE free-text classification fails closed without saving
unknown save outcome keeps one command and reads authoritative state before retry
an already accepted unknown command is not submitted a second time
component conflict replaces stale revisions with the strict current view
Safety overlay clears ordinary cache and never reports ordinary success
